61:6.text: , said: "O Children of Israel! I am the Messenger of Allâh unto you, confirming the Taurât
before me, and giving glad tidings of a Messenger to come after me, whose name shall be Ahmad.
(Ahmad i.e. Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
came to them with clear proofs, they said: "This is plain magic."

61:7.text: And who does more wrong than the one who invents a lie against Allâh, while he is being invited to Islâm? And Allâh guides not the people who are Zâlimûn

61:8.text: They intend to put out the Light of Allâh
(i.e. the Religion of Islâm, this Qur’ân, and the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)
with their mouths. But Allâh will bring His Light to perfection even though the disbelievers hate

61:9.text: He it is Who has sent His Messenger
with guidance and the religion of truth
to make it victorious over all
(polytheists, pagans, idolaters, and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)

61:10.text: O you who believe! Shall I guide you to a trade that will save you from a painful torment?

61:11.text: That you believe in Allâh and His Messenger
and that you strive hard and fight in the Cause of Allâh with your wealth and your lives: that will be better for you, if you but know!

61:12.text: He will forgive you your sins, and admit you into Gardens under which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in ‘Adn
Paradise; that is indeed the great success.

61:13.text: which you love, - help from Allâh
and a near victory. And give glad tidings

61:14.text: O you who believe! Be you helpers
(i.e. we will strive in His Cause!)
. Then a group of the Children of Israel believed and a group disbelieved. So We gave power to those who believed against their enemies, and they became the victorious
